# Test to expose float16 accumulation stall at 2048: 2050 tiles of 1.0
# Original (float32 acc) -> 2050.0 -> f16 = 2050.0
# Mutant (float16 acc) stalls at 2048.0 after 2048 tiles, stays 2048.0
# Reference (torch.matmul f32 acc) -> 2050.0 -> f16 = 2050.0
def test_accumulation_stall_2050():
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    M, N, K = 1, 1, 32 * 2050  # 65600, exactly 2050 tiles
    a = torch.zeros((M, K), dtype=torch.float16)
    b = torch.zeros((K, N), dtype=torch.float16)
    for i in range(0, K, 32):
        a[0, i] = 1.0
        b[i, 0] = 1.0
    ref = torch.matmul(a, b)  # 2050.0 exactly representable in f16
    out = matmul(a, b)
    # Mutant produces 2048.0, diff=2.0 > 0.125
    assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=0.125, rtol=0), f"stall 2050 mismatch: out={out.item()}, ref={ref.item()}"

test_accumulation_stall_2050()
